NARYX_TERMINAL_ORIGIN.$operator: exact HTTPS origin of the deployed web terminal, for example https://terminal.example

NARYX_SOLVER_ED25519_KEY_PATH.$operator: absolute path, outside the repository, of the solver Ed25519 PKCS8 PEM key file (the path only; the key is never read here)

NARYX_SOLVER_ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY_HEX.$operator: 64 lowercase hex characters of that key's public key

NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVATE_TERMINAL_API_BASE_UR.$operator: public HTTPS base URL that reaches services/api

NEXT_PUBLIC_NARYX_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL.$operator: public HTTPS base URL of the public v1 market API

NEXT_PUBLIC_NARYX_PACKAGE_MARKET_ID.$operator: package market id the chart and book show, or an empty string
